section.p: With over 8 years of specialized experience, PrimeGear delivers ISO-aligned, globally accredited training programs developed in collaboration with international academic partners — equipping engineers with real-world expertise and internationally recognized certifications across key reliability disciplines.

div.h2: Reliability Is the Foundation of Industrial Performance
div.p: More than a maintenance function, reliability represents a complete operational approach — enhancing equipment availability, optimizing costs, improving safety, and enabling organizations to operate with greater efficiency and control.
PrimeGear's programs translate this approach into practice, equipping industrial teams with the structured methodologies and field-tested skills needed to drive measurable operational performance.

div.div: Training grounded in real industrial practice.

Shaped with leading global academic partners.

div.h2: More Than Training — A Globally Recognized Reliability Partner.

div.p: Our programs are built on internationally accredited standards and strengthened by global academic partnerships — combining structured methodologies with hands-on industrial experience to deliver training that translates directly into measurable operational performance.

Backed by a decade of proven engineering expertise, global standards, and reliability excellence, PrimeGear equips engineers and industrial teams with the skills, credentials, and confidence to lead reliability transformation in their organizations.

div.h2: Globally Recognized Certifications That Define Expertise
div.p: PrimeGear delivers internationally accredited certification programs across core reliability disciplines — combining ISO-aligned methodologies, real field application, and global best practices to develop highly specialized, industry-recognized professionals.
Focuses on lubrication best practices, oil analysis, and contamination control to enhance equipment reliability, reduce wear, and extend asset life.
Develops diagnostic capabilities to detect, analyze, and prevent mechanical faults — supporting effective predictive maintenance and improved machine performance.
Enables early detection of leaks, friction, and electrical issues using ultrasonic technology to support proactive maintenance and energy efficiency.
Utilizes thermal imaging to identify temperature anomalies in mechanical and electrical systems, enabling early fault detection and preventive action.
